record_title: Exact triplet cancellation collapses the second-order sync–splay stability overlap
provenance: Coefficient matching and exact linear-stability analysis of the second-order Stuart–Landau phase reduction and engineered physical nonpairwise coupling in the cited source.
limitations: Three Stuart–Landau oscillators with straight isochrones and no self-coupling; the exact cancellation is for the retained mixed-order phase model through second order, not the full finite-coupling physical system. The stability result is local and concerns synchrony and splay only. Explicit triplet harmonics are canceled, but other second-order corrections and path-dependent emergent provenance remain.

artifact_inventory.description: Standalone SymPy verification of the pairwise residual identity and exact sync–splay transverse-stability relation after 1:1:2 motif cancellation.
